architecture_path.description: Path to Architecture.md. Cron jobs, integrations, and component deployment dependencies extracted from here.

prisma_schema_path.description: Path to Prisma_Schema_Proposal.prisma. Determines migration needs.

migration_risk_path.description: Optional path to migration risk analysis section in Risk_Register.md or Deployment_Strategy.md from migration-risk-analysis-skill.

cron_jobs.description: Cron jobs to configure. If omitted, extracted from Architecture.md.

name.description: Human-readable name of the cron job (e.g., 'Nightly Score Sync').

path.description: Route path for the cron job (e.g., /api/cron/nightly-score-sync).

rollback_rto_minutes.description: Recovery Time Objective for application rollback in minutes. Default: 5 minutes via Vercel Instant Rollback.

staged_rollout_required.description: Whether the PRD requires a staged rollout (10% → 50% → 100%).

existing_strategy_path.description: Optional path to existing Deployment_Strategy.md being revised.
